purpose: Source material for implementation review and later project documents/presentations. Per-commit CI evidence is authoritative; never promote an implemented claim to empirical validation without measurements.

claims.claim: Real connectome-based insect control and an independent learned drone are mandatory, not an optional replacement by procedural behaviour.
claims.source: User requirement and explicit correction; EXECUTION-BRIEF.md section 2

claims.claim: All 165122 Traced MaleCNS v1.0 neurons and all 25563197 internal positive neuron-pair rows are preserved, representing 124025046 synapses.
claims.evidence: scripts/prepare-neural.py; assets/neural/manifest.json; source audit run 36055243868; asset build run 36055657037
claims.qualification: Not every raw segmentation fragment; no extra graph/weight cutoff.

claims.claim: All selected neurons have explicit LIF state and original-edge delayed propagation.
claims.qualification: Modeled physiology, not neuron-specific electrophysiology or Brian2-equivalent reproduction.

claims.claim: Delayed synthetic visual input enters real named populations; propagated output spikes influence the force-driven body through an explicit decoder.
claims.qualification: Engineered visual encoder, motor decoder and wing stabilizer remain. Full browser verification is established only by the linked per-commit run.

claims.claim: All retained synapses have fully reconstructed physiological function.
claims.qualification: False as a current product claim. 4143 neurons and 1023493 connections have zero outgoing efficacy under unresolved/neuromodulatory handling; receptor-specific effects and plasticity are missing.

claims.claim: The closed-loop controller reproduces natural measured fly flight and escape distributions.
claims.requiredEvidence: Held-out biological trajectories, reaction timing, wing kinematics and perturbation comparisons; no such validation has yet been completed.

claims.claim: The Drosophila model is a validated mosquito escape opponent.
claims.requiredEvidence: Species-specific mosquito calibration and held-out evaluation.

claims.claim: The drone has its own trainable residual DQN and separate observations/checkpoint, with no neural-state input.
claims.evidence: src/workers/training.worker.js; neural-training.json from the actual Chromium workflow
claims.qualification: Two held-out seeds per full-neural controller comparison; not enough for a meaningful superiority claim.

claims.claim: Learned control outperforms the baseline in general.
claims.qualification: Retain negative results. The earlier short mechanical-opponent training run performed worse; later full-neural results must be reported with their exact denominator and conditions.

claims.claim: The drone is safe for operation in an occupied home.
claims.evidence: Issue #2; original benchmark records moving-occupant collisions in seeds 42 and 234.
claims.qualification: Exact-map filter and synthetic sensors; no physical hardware validation.
Electrical output is impossible in this repository. Contact and neutralisation are separate outcomes.

claims.claim: Runtime uses same-origin website assets and browser workers, without a mandatory Python backend or cloud model.
claims.evidence: Relative module/asset paths, CSP, real browser request audit and static build; scientific Python is build/test tooling only.

localDiagnosticHistory.configuration: 200 ms left/right loom, whole graph, initially inherited alignHeading=true
localDiagnosticHistory.observation: Backward body-relative readout caused the stabilizer to chase its own changing heading. Left approach x=-0.00926737 m; right approach x=0.00903310 m.
localDiagnosticHistory.correction: Neural adapter sets alignHeading=false. Updated local run: left x=0.01996467 m, right x=-0.01971299 m. Full causal controls remain required.
localDiagnosticHistory.qualification: No fitted biological direction/latency claim; this is a software adapter correction, not a scientific discovery.

presentationRules: Link each numerical claim to source asset or exact run/commit.
Do not label graph coverage as complete physiology.
Do not turn software verification into biological validation or hardware readiness.
Actual spikes and trajectories only; no decorative activity presented as evidence.
